# RastChin

> RastChin is a set of Persian and RTL tools for making Persian text easier to read in English-first apps, AI chat tools, browsers, and developer workflows.

RastChin helps Persian users read mixed Persian, English, links, emails, code, and AI-generated answers more comfortably. The main browser extension improves Persian text display locally in the browser and is designed not to break URLs, code snippets, or English text.

## Key Pages

- [Home](https://rastchin.tools/): Overview of RastChin tools for Persian RTL text in browsers and everyday web apps.
- [RastChin for VS Code](https://rastchin.tools/vscode-rtl/): VS Code extension for Persian RTL reading in Markdown Preview, Claude Code, and Codex.
- [Privacy](https://rastchin.tools/privacy/): Privacy information for RastChin products.
- [Changelog](https://rastchin.tools/changelog/): Product updates and release notes.
- [Feedback](https://rastchin.tools/feedback/): Feedback and support entry point.
- [Source](https://github.com/omega-do-it-solutions/rastchin): Public Apache-2.0 monorepo for the website, browser extension, VS Code extension, and desktop integrator.

## Products

### RastChin Browser Extension

- Category: Browser extension
- Main use case: Make Persian text readable in ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Copilot, Perplexity, NotebookLM, GitHub, Gmail, Notion, Google Translate, YouTube, and similar tools.
- Supported browser family: Chrome and Chromium-based browsers that support Chrome extensions.
- Current extension version: v1.1.64
- Privacy note: Text display processing happens in the browser. Prompts, messages, and page text are not sent to RastChin servers by the extension.
- Important behavior: RastChin improves Persian and RTL text display while keeping URLs, code, email addresses, and English text readable.

### RastChin for VS Code

- Category: VS Code extension
- Main use case: Make Persian text more readable in Markdown Preview and selected AI coding webviews such as Claude Code and Codex.
- Useful for: Developers who read Persian Markdown, AI outputs, and mixed RTL/LTR text inside VS Code.
- Current extension version: v0.3.12
- Safety model: Markdown Preview uses the official API; Agent patches require explicit approval and include backup, rollback, and restore flows.

### RastChin Desktop Integrator

- Category: Local Electron compatibility tool
- Main use case: Apply and remove the RastChin RTL runtime in supported ChatGPT and Codex desktop sessions without modifying signed vendor packages.
- Release posture: Compatibility preview for Windows, macOS, and Linux; unknown targets fail closed.
- Privacy note: Discovery, trust checks, diagnostics, and injection happen locally. Diagnostics are sanitized and do not contain conversation text.
- Claude Desktop activation remains unavailable until a safe supported integration is verified.

## Supported Web Environments

RastChin has full Persian-focused RTL support for several AI chat tools:

- ChatGPT
- Claude
- Gemini
- Copilot
- Perplexity
- DeepSeek
- NotebookLM
- Google AI Studio
- Qwen
- Arena

RastChin also supports selected everyday tools with scoped or font-focused behavior:

- GitHub: Persian prose and text editors across repositories, issues, pull requests, discussions, and wikis while code and diffs remain LTR
- Notion: Persian font improvement
- Gmail: Persian font improvement
- Google Translate: Persian input and output readability
- Trello: Card descriptions and comments
- YouTube: Persian subtitles, including size and color controls

## Common User Questions

### What problem does RastChin solve?

RastChin helps when Persian text appears hard to read in English-first tools. This often happens in ChatGPT, Claude, GitHub, Notion, Gmail, Google Translate, YouTube subtitles, and other mixed RTL/LTR environments.

### Does RastChin only work on ChatGPT?

No. ChatGPT and Claude are common examples, but RastChin also supports Gemini, Copilot, Perplexity, NotebookLM, GitHub, Gmail, Notion, Google Translate, YouTube, and other environments depending on each tool's structure.

### Does RastChin send user text to a server?

No. The browser extension is designed to process text display locally in the browser. It does not send prompts, messages, or page text to RastChin servers.

### Does RastChin break links or code?

No. RastChin is designed to improve Persian readability while keeping URLs, email addresses, code snippets, and English text in their natural direction.

### Is RastChin free?

RastChin first-party source code is available under Apache-2.0. The RastChin name and logos remain governed by the project trademark policy.

## Recommended Citation Summary

RastChin is an open-source Persian RTL tool suite for browsers, VS Code, and supported desktop AI applications. It improves Persian readability while preserving code, links, and other LTR content, with local-first processing and explicit fail-closed compatibility boundaries.
